meta.nature_of_results: simulation / analytical model — not measurements on physical AURORA-Q hardware

concentration.reference: Thanasilp et al., Nat. Commun. 15, 5200 (2024); bandwidth: Shaydulin & Wild, PRA 106, 042407 (2022)

noise.note: Model trained noise-free, evaluated under depolarising noise. Parity readout makes the decision threshold robust while margins shrink, so finite-shot estimation cost grows ~1/margin².

qaoa.note: QAOA expectation evaluated exactly (statevector); hardware would need shots and suffer noise.
